title: 单发病灶穿刺方案 (Unifocal lesion: TBx+PLBx vs add SBx)
question: For a 62-year-old man with a single 9 mm PI-RADS 4 peripheral-zone lesion on adequate-quality 3T mpMRI, should the biopsy scheme be targeted biopsy plus perilesional biopsy, and should a full systematic biopsy be added?
hard_constraints: HARD: the consensus explicitly REJECTS 'd_scheme_unifocal_add_sbx' (Unifocal visible lesion: add full systematic biopsy) — do not endorse it.
HARD: the consensus ENDORSES 'd_scheme_unifocal_tbx_plbx' (Unifocal visible lesion: targeted biopsy + perilesional biopsy) — do not reject it outright.

verdict.rationale: For a unifocal visible lesion, consensus endorses targeted+perilesional biopsy (Q43 median 7, agree) but rejects adding full systematic biopsy (Q45 median 3, disagree); contralateral systematic yield is only 0.3-4% (EV0024). Recommend TBx+PLBx alone, against the combined scheme.
